organization.short_description:
Bosch China is the Chinese subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, a leading German technology and service company established in 1909. It is the largest Bosch workforce outside Germany and serves as Bosch's second-largest market globally. With approximately 57,000 associates and 78 legal entities across China, Bosch China recorded consolidated sales of 149.8 billion CNY in 2025. The company is committed to investing over 60 billion CNY in the region.

Bosch China operates in four core business sectors: Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. It provides a wide range of products, including automotive components, industrial automation solutions, household appliances, and energy-efficient building systems. The company focuses on innovation, sustainability, and digitalization, targeting both B2B and B2C markets, including automotive manufacturers, industrial enterprises, and retail consumers. Bosch China emphasizes its commitment to local development and eco-friendly technologies, aiming to enhance quality of life through advanced solutions.
